about:
As Co-Founder of Electric Eye, my focus is on propelling e-commerce brands to new heights through innovative brand strategy and management. With a deep understanding of the Shopify platform, highlighted by the recent Shopify Foundations certification, our team excels in crafting tailored solutions that enhance brand identity and customer engagement.

The mission that drives us is the desire to see our clients' brands connect authentically with their audiences. We've successfully translated this vision into impactful design and strategic financial management, ensuring each project resonates with the target market. Collaborating closely with our clients, we help unveil the full potential of their digital presence, fostering growth and lasting customer relationships.
